name: Superpowers Bridge
description: Bridge to Superpowers workflow skills - auto-fetches from GitHub and injects relevant skills into the agent prompt

skillsRepo.description: Git repository URL for Superpowers skills

autoDetectCode.description: Auto-detect code tasks and inject relevant skills

autoUpdate.description: Run git pull on plugin start (not recommended)

injectionMode.description: summary = skill names + descriptions only; full = inject full skill bodies

maxInjectedChars.description: Hard cap on injected context size (0 = unlimited)

injectOncePerSession.description: Inject each skill at most once per session

autoSelectSkills.description: Optional whitelist of skill names eligible for auto-selection

extraKeywords.description: Extra trigger keywords per skill name, merged with built-ins
